name: Debate-Based Career Guidance Agent with Complementary Personas
description: A Responsible AI (RAI) multi-persona dialectic debate system (Planner, Critic, Ethics-Reviewer) using local LLMs (Qwen), Neo4j knowledge graphs, and vector retrieval to generate balanced career guidance with calibrated uncertainty and human override.
tech_stack: Chroma / FAISS (Vector DB for Course & Role Data)
conventions: Modular multi-agent design with strict persona prompt contracts
Grounded evidence retrieval linking every claim to Neo4j nodes or vector chunks
Calibrated uncertainty estimation explicitly separated from agent confidence
Human-in-the-loop override mechanics built into the state graph
Strict RAI fairness checks across demographic and socio-economic synthetic profiles
architecture_patterns: Dialectic Multi-Agent Debate (Planner, Critic, Ethics-Reviewer, Arbiter/Synthesizer)
GraphRAG combining Neo4j graph traversals and dense vector retrieval
Counterfactual fairness evaluation via synthetic paired profiles

file_structure.docs: Academic and system documentation, literature survey, and evaluation specs
file_structure.src/agents: Planner, Critic, Ethics-Reviewer, and Arbiter persona implementations
file_structure.src/graph: Neo4j ontology, graph queries, and skill taxonomy loaders
file_structure.src/rag: Vector database ingestion, retrieval, and citation verification
file_structure.src/eval: Metrics engine for evidence diversity, contradiction resolution, and fairness audits
file_structure.src/ui: Streamlit debate trace viewer with human override controls

patterns: Unit tests for persona prompts and state transitions
Retrieval grounding and citation verification tests
Fairness delta unit tests on counterfactual profile pairs

never_do: Never generate monolithic, one-sided career advice without adversarial critique
Never drop unresolved ethical or feasibility contradictions from the final synthesis
Never emit uncalibrated 100% confidence career trajectories
Never suppress human override or force autonomous career decisions
Never produce hallucinated job statistics without ontology or citation grounding
preferred_patterns: Practice extreme token economy: dense, high-signal, academic-grade rigor
Structured JSON output schemas for all agent debate turns
Formal epistemic uncertainty scoring using Conformal / Bayesian calibration
